lines.port: // The German keyboard's characters, worked out from the layout instead of kept as a copy of the German cartridge's table (a clean release
// carries no FireRed table): letters run in order eight to a row from the page's first one, the 9th column has '.' and ',', the last row has
// two letters and the three umlauts; the symbols page has the digits in order and two rows of punctuation (no table at all, not even a short one).
static u8 CtrKeyboardCharDE(int page, int row, int col)
u8 first = page == KEYBOARD_LETTERS_LOWER ? 0xd5 : 0xbb, umlaut = page == KEYBOARD_LETTERS_LOWER ? 0xf4 : 0xf1;
return col < 2 ? 0xab + col : col < 4 ? 0xb5 + col - 2 : col == 4 ? 0xba : 0xae;
return col < 8 ? first + row * 8 + col : row == 0 ? 0xad : row == 1 ? 0xb8 : 0x00;
